summary.text: Jason Blair is a Republican member of the Oklahoma House of Representatives who has represented District 53 since November 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A commercial insurance and risk management advisor, he advanced from the Republican primary on June 16, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Jason Blair earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Oklahoma in 2003, and his career experience includes working as a commercial insurance and risk management advisor.
Blair assumed office on November 20, 2024, succeeding Mark McBride, and for 2025-2026 was assigned to the Administrative Rules Committee.
